summary: Strong test suite with comprehensive coverage of all major features (JUnit/JSON parsing, aggregation, flaky detection, markdown rendering, CLI, and GitHub Actions workflow). Unit tests are well-organized and readable with good use of fixtures and helpers. Integration tests via act verify the full pipeline end-to-end with exact value assertions. Main gaps: edge cases (empty arrays, boundary values, malformed inputs beyond basic validation) and error scenarios (permission errors, single file inputs) are underexplored. Test design is excellent with proper isolation via temp directories and git repos. Would reliably catch regressions in core functionality but some complex edge cases might slip through.
